Name: Ruska's Pygmy Goats
Author: Tiriel
TagLine: Very simple mod that replaces regular goats with pygmy goats.
Description:
This mod uses CP to replace the original SDV .png files for the adult and baby goats. I haven't tested if it works with other mods that change animals, but it __should__ work as long as said mods don't do anything with the original goat .png files.

* Adult pygmy goats are shorter than regular goats, have different eyes, bigger horns, more hair, etc.
* Baby pygmy goats are smaller and have more 'baby-like' features.
* Don't panic if you see the regular goat icon at Marnie's shop. I haven't changed it yet.
* Inspiration for the adult goat sprites came from [this good-looking individual](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/a/aa/Too_much_ramming.jpg).
